Element.Description: Maximum number of objects generated when the active generator receives SetToZero. Each GeneratorConnection/Activate target is used at most once per activation. Generation stops when no targets or follower locations remain.
Removes each selected follower location from the current generation batch so it cannot be selected again. With this disabled, multiple generated objects can use the same follower.
Preserves the generated actor's original orientation instead of copying the follower's transform. Its position is still set from the follower and Offset.

Uses the message originator as the follower when there are no active GeneratorConnection/Follow targets. With this disabled, the message sender is used instead. KeepOrientation still controls whether the follower's orientation is copied.
Position offset added to the selected follower's translation. For a swarm follower, it is added to the last killed member's position instead. The offset is not rotated with the follower.
Lower bound of the random multiplier applied to each generated actor's existing model scale. RandomScaleMax supplies the upper bound.
Upper bound of the random multiplier applied to each generated actor's existing model scale. RandomScaleMin supplies the lower bound.
